question: Gulabo Sapera is associated with which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kalbelia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padma Shri awardee, Gulabo Sapera is a Kalbelia dancer of Rajasthan.**
 
• The Kalbelia are a tribe of snake charmers located in the Thar Desert in Rajasthan. 
 
• Both men and **women can perform the Kalbelia dance,** which is an essential component of their culture.
 
• The Kalbelia dance is also known as the** "Sapera Dance" and "Snake Charmer Dance".**
 
• **Beginning in 2010, Rajasthan's Kalbelia dance and songs were added to UNESCO's **representative list of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
 
• At the Kalbelia dance, men play a variety of traditional instruments as women dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**Dance of Kalbelia**

__
 
• Panihari Dance - Dance performed by both men and women
 
• Indauli Dance - Dance performed by both men and women in doubles
 
• Sankariya Dance - love affair The couple is based on dance.
 
• Bagdiya Dance - This dance performed by women only while begging.
